newsitem.title: UK: Abbot buys Nabors Europe, issues shares.
newsitem.headline: Abbot buys Nabors Europe, issues shares.

text.p: Abbot Group Plc, the drilling contractor for the oil and gas industry, said it conditionally agreed to buy Nabors Europe from Nabors Industries Inc for 24.7 million stg.
Abbott also announced a one-for-five placing and open offer at 83 pence per share to raise 17.6 million stg to help finance the acquisition.
Aberdeen-based Nabors Europe provides drilling and drilling related facilities.
In the year to September 30, 1995 Nabors Europe posted a pre-tax profit 0f 269,000 stg on sales of 30.26 million stg.

Abbot said it may start reorganising Nabors to achieve a more acceptable level of profit margin. Chairman Alasdair Locke said he was confident Nabors Europe would make a positive contribution to the performance of Abbot's unit KCA Drilling Group Ltd.
Abbot expects the acquisition to be completed on November 14, subject to shareholders approving the purchase at an extraordinary meeting on November 11.
Nabors Europe currently operates nine rigs on production platforms for Chevron, Elf and Oryx.
It also provides wireline logging and remedial services, a business which has considerable potential, Abbot said.
"This is an excellent acquisition which...will provide significant opportunities to extend our well engineering capability to a wider client portfolio," Locke said in a statement.
